constraint_formula: raw R=max(R,0); raw eta=max(eta,0); if R+sum(eta)>1, scale eta by (1-R)/sum(eta); T=sum(eta).
history_policy: M5/M5A frozen artifacts remain immutable; M5B outputs are corrected/superseding evidence.
model_selection: Use corrected schema, numerical order-profile, eta(+1), ranking, worst geometry, P/S contrast and physics consistency; no single-metric winner.
normalization: fold-local only; no row-level split or global fit
outer_cv: 13-fold geometry LOGO; P/S and all 11 wavelengths held out together
residual_formula: For LF-compatible eta outputs: delta=HF-LF; eta_hat=LF_eta+delta_hat. R is a direct head because LF_R is unavailable.
scope: development-only small refit after completed deterministic no-refit replay
